items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Saturday, Mr. Gus Schultz was the manager -- he was really the maitre d' of the club.

ctx.x: And you're still writing arrangements, I guess, and, are the people dancing now to your, are they still listening --

Oh yes we had to play that, and that's one thing I wanted to tell you. In the Club Alabam, you could play any dancing you want until Saturday. But Saturday, Mr. Gus Schultz was the manager -- he was really the maitre d' of the club. He wouldn't stand for no four beats. You know, like, (plays piano). know why? Because he said it was sensuous music. And that would start women to twirlin' and movin', you see. And guys huggin' them close like that. You could play it more like, (sings), "Toot toot tootsie, goodbye",…
